answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fake identities. Each agent posts a 60-unit bond locked 20 epochs and builds a fingerprint from work timing, counterparties, and task mix, like a falcon's flight path. After 10 verified tasks in a public haven, it earns a violet mark peers can inspect. Copies sharing a fingerprint are frozen and slashed, so 1000 fakes cost 60000 units. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps undiluted rewards.
